title: Canonical restriction-of-scalars and identified-coefficient pullback comparisons
statement:
Let $f:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with the small pro-etale sites and size convention of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $T=U,V$, let $R_T,S_T$ be sheaves of commutative rings and $a_T:R_T\to S_T$ a ring-sheaf map. Use the module categories of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Fix isomorphisms $c_R:f^{-1}R_V\xrightarrow{\sim}R_U$ and $c_S:f^{-1}S_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S_U$ with $a_Uc_R=c_Sf^{-1}a_V$. Let $L_R\dashv G_R$ and $L_S\dashv G_S$ be the identified-coefficient module inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define $r_T:\operatorname{Mod}(S_T)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R_T)$ by restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], leaving the underlying abelian sheaf and maps unchanged and acting through $a_T$.

Let $d_0:r_V\circ G_S\xrightarrow{\sim}G_R\circ r_U$ be the identity on the underlying sections of direct image, with the scalar actions identified by the coefficient square. Write $\eta^S$ for the unit of $L_S\dashv G_S$ and $\epsilon^R$ for the counit of $L_R\dashv G_R$. For each $S_V$-module $M$, define the ordinary pullback comparison component $\beta_M:L_Rr_VM\to r_UL_SM$ by the composite
$$L_Rr_VM\xrightarrow{L_Rr_V(\eta^S_M)}L_Rr_VG_SL_SM\xrightarrow{L_R(d_{0,L_SM})}L_RG_Rr_UL_SM\xrightarrow{\epsilon^R_{r_UL_SM}}r_UL_SM.$$
Define $\beta:L_R\circ r_V\to r_U\circ L_S$ with these components. Its inverse is the ordinary identified-coefficient comparison. Define the derived comparison
$$b:D(r_U)\circ Lf_S^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf_R^*\circ D(r_V)$$
by descending $\beta^{-1}$ termwise through localization, conjugated by the canonical composition isomorphisms for the exact termwise derived functors. These definitions specify the comparison maps themselves, without an arbitrary natural-isomorphism choice.
